resources.string: This app is managed from scrcpy4Frame on the Steam Frame. The Frame installs it and grants its permissions over adb, so there is nothing to set up here. It forwards your notifications to the headset while scrcpy4Frame is connected, and keeps Wireless debugging on only while scrcpy4Frame is open on the Frame.
Wireless debugging only while scrcpy4Frame is open

Turns Wireless debugging on when scrcpy4Frame opens on the Frame and off when it closes. If the Frame goes to sleep or leaves the Wi-Fi instead, it turns off about a minute later. Needs Android 11+ and WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. Android still asks once per Wi-Fi network unless you chose \"Always allow on this network\".
